text: Japan's July headline inflation reached 1.9%, with core inflation at 1.8% and core-core at 1.9%. Energy prices increased for the first time since November despite subsidies, fresh food rose 7%, and wholesale inflation reached 7.2%.

meta.note: Government energy subsidies remain embedded in consumer prices, limiting direct comparison with wholesale pressure.

text: Citadel acquired public-market assets from Situational Awareness and has unwound over 80% of the portfolio's aggregate risk through more than 100 block trades totaling over $4 billion in market value. Situational Awareness had held concentrated AI-linked positions.

meta.note: The disclosed 80% measure refers to aggregate risk rather than the proportion of assets sold.
